title: Kirby Problem 3.59
exact_target: Prove that sutured instanton and sutured Heegaard Floer homology agree over the complex numbers for every balanced sutured manifold, including the closed-manifold and knot special cases.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2857 (KP-3.59). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (editors), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), Problem 3.59, p. 173 and following remarks; original author version.
